newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville raises Thurs prices $1.50-3.00 a MWh.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville raises Thurs prices $1.50-3.00 a MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised prices for Thursday deliveries during off-peak hours by $1.50 to $3.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the federal agency said Wednesday.
BPA continued to refrain from offering surplus power during peak demand hours and to offer up to 500 MW of firm light-load power and 300 MW of non-firm.
For Thursday, firm prices increased to $20.00 per MWh for both Northwest and California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
BPA raised prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 PST on Wednesday to $20.50 per MWh for all deliveries, compared with $19.00 for Wednesday deals.
Non-firm power for hours ending 0600 and 2300 was offered at $24.00, up from $21.00 for Wednesday.
